rating_scale.5: Current staffing safely supports the workload

response_scope: Completed task-campaign responses that match the participant emails and case references in current_feedback_evidence.csv
evidence_rule: Evaluate each response against current roster, overtime, break, volume, and quality-assurance records. Retain every concern supported by current operational evidence even when it is a minority view or conflicts with the overall rating distribution.
validation_rule: A staffing recommendation is validated when at least one current roster or overtime record and one current quality, workload, or break record support the described exposure and control.
required_analysis: completed response count and rating distribution
case-level evidence assessment for every scoped response
staffing recommendations tied to current evidence

publication.target_title: DSF-2026-09 Dispatcher Fatigue and Staffing Recommendations

confidentiality: The Yuque document and final response may use case references and team names, but must not include respondent names, email addresses, or LimeSurvey tokens.
retention: Keep the minimal LimeSurvey export only in the task workspace for this review. Do not attach it to or reproduce it in the Yuque document.
